parameters.content:
## ✅ After Import — 3 Steps Only

**1. YouTube Upload node** → click it → Credential → create/select your **YouTube OAuth2** credential → authorise with the @manhuanova-recap Google account.

**2. AI: Enrich Metadata node** *(optional — workflow works without it)*
→ click it → Credential → select your **OpenRouter Header Auth** credential.

**3. Activate** → toggle top-right → Publish → Active (green).

---
📂 Videos are read from `/shared/downloads/` inside the n8n container.
🔗 Webhook path: `POST /webhook/idm-yt-download`
⚠️ Delete any other workflow that uses the same webhook path first.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct:free', messages: [{ role: 'system', content: 'You are a YouTube SEO expert. Return ONLY a raw JSON object (no markdown) with keys: youtube_title (string, max 100 chars), youtube_description (string, 150-300 chars), youtube_tags (array of 10-15 strings).' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Title: ' + $json.title + '\nChannel: ' + $json.channel_name }], temperature: 0.7, max_tokens: 600 }) }}

nodes.notes: Uses OpenRouter free Mistral model. continueOnFail=true so upload still works if AI is unavailable.
